label: Finding-128
title: Wersm says Palo Alto Networks and Trail of Bits reported confirmed compromises; no primary capture says so
description: Wersm (captured 26 October 01:31 UTC) writes, secondhand from TechCrunch: 'Palo Alto Networks and Trail of Bits later reported confirmed compromises and post-exploit activity'. Palo Alto's own PSIRT bulletin (captured 22 October 19:17 UTC, sha256 16cb7bd74aee...) says it is 'not aware of any malicious exploitation of this issue against our products'; no capture of Trail of Bits or a TechCrunch article is in the vault. No victim is named, so the site's claim about a named organisation holds. Ask for: the TechCrunch article and any Trail of Bits post, captured. Not changed by the desk.
